strings.list2.title: بازار، تفریح گاہیں اور زرعی فارم
strings.list2.lead: تاریخی سوق القیصریہ سے لے کر نخلستان کے باغوں اور فارموں تک: خریداری کریں، چہل قدمی کریں اور الاحساء کی نعمتوں کا ذائقہ چکھیں۔

tempted_but_not_added.what: Naming what one shops for and tastes in the lead (the Hasawi bisht, dates, coffee and spices of the Qaisariyah; the farms' dates and lemons) — what this reader actually plans a souq visit around.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: Not in this string's source, English or Arabic. The lead says only 'shop, stroll and taste the bounty'; the goods are on the attraction pages the cards link to. Fence of role file 03.

tempted_but_not_added.what: A planning cue for the Gulf-resident reader: the evening as the time for the souq and the parks, shade, or 'a weekend outing for the family' («خاندان کے ساتھ ہفتے کے آخر کی سیر»).
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: No time of day, season, duration or audience stands in the source of the lead. The Qaisariyah's evening hours are a fact of its own page, not of this index. Fence.

tempted_but_not_added.what: A gloss for «سوق» in the lead («سوق القیصریہ نامی بازار», P3c point 2, or a bracket), since this reader may read «سوق» as «شوق».
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: The string is also the page's meta description: P3c-labels has the name stand bare there, byte for byte its key, with the plain generic in the neighbouring line — and the neighbouring line is the h1 / snippet title «بازار، تفریح گاہیں اور زرعی فارم», which opens with «بازار». The approved cat.market.d writes the name bare in the same way. A gloss is a ruling's matter, not a localizer's choice; not reopened.

tempted_but_not_added.what: Naming the oasis in the lead («الاحساء کے نخلستان کے باغوں …») for a reader who knows nothing of Al-Ahsa and meets the lead alone as a search snippet.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: Not an added fact (the oasis the source means is Al-Ahsa's), but it is ruling N47's question, which stage 1 put to stage 4 with a drafted alternative; ruling a ruling's scope is not this stage's job, and the change would also move the source's closing 'Al-Ahsa' to 'here'. Left to stage 4 (see notes).

notes.text: No change. The three strings carry nothing this audience needs adapted: no unit, time, fee, date, administrative unit, UNESCO term or Gulf-specific term; no religious content and no devotional framing (the «نعمتوں» of the lead renders the source's 'bounty' / «خيرات» of the land's produce; it is the ordinary Urdu word for good things to eat and adds no 'God's' or blessing formula). Heading and label strings take no gloss (gloss_regel, P3c-labels).

Kept (approved nav.leisure pair). For this reader the label is the right map of the page: «بازار» (not «سوق»), «تفریح گاہیں» (the native word for parks, P16), and «زرعی فارم», the press's qualified form that keeps the farm from reading as a form to fill in (N5). It matches the header label word for word and the crumb «بازار اور تفریح گاہیں» is its shortening — no contradiction on the page.
Kept (approved list.eyebrow pair). «سیاحتی رہنما» is the same eyebrow as the sister attractions index, as ru/de/zh give both indexes the same eyebrow.

Kept as stage 2 left it. «تاریخی سوق القیصریہ» tells the reader who knows nothing of Al-Ahsa that this is a historic place without a superlative (the source's 'storied'); «نخلستان کے باغوں اور فارموں» names the two kinds of green place the page lists, and the closing «الاحساء کی …» ties the oasis to Al-Ahsa inside the same sentence; the three imperatives (shop, stroll, taste) are the source's own three activities and match what a family on a day out or a weekend from the Eastern Province or Riyadh does here — no emphasis needed beyond the source's.

For stage 4 (ruling N47, as stage 1 raised it): this reader is assumed to know nothing of Al-Ahsa, and the lead is also the meta description, read alone under the snippet title. Read alone, the oasis is identified by the same sentence's close («الاحساء کی نعمتوں کا ذائقہ چکھیں»), so the snippet is understood; N47's form («الاحساء کے نخلستان») is not in the string. Whether N47's 'page' is the index page (whose cards include the sawsan-gardens summary «الاحساء کے نخلستان کے ماحول میں ایک باغ،», per stage 1's trace) or the string itself is a ruling's scope, not this stage's. If stage 4 names the oasis, stage 1's alternative applies with stage 2's collocation: «تاریخی سوق القیصریہ سے لے کر الاحساء کے نخلستان کے باغوں اور فارموں تک: خریداری کریں، چہل قدمی کریں اور یہاں کی نعمتوں کا ذائقہ چکھیں۔»
